title: ico penalty-schema feed payload, majors 1 and 2
description: The payload half of the one feed envelope (ADR-0019) for ico's penalty-schema feed, majors 1 and 2. regime -> violation type -> fine formula and cap, grounded in real public enforcement notices. Superseded by payload.schema.json (major 3), which adds control_weights; the two schemas exist side by side because a payload_schema change is always a major and a consumer pinned to v1 or v2 still validates against this file.

regimes.description: Keyed by regime name, e.g. uk-gdpr. The name an adopter declares in its obligations.

formula.description: One of pct_of_global_turnover, per_month_escalating, per_violation_tier, pct_of_relevant_revenue_plus_discretion. Each carries its own rate, cap or band fields; the converter beside this feed reads them.
